summary: Unlock your potential as an ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer. Learn to implement effective privacy management systems and enhance organizational compliance.
audienceIntro: This ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer course is designed for privacy and security professionals who lead, design, or support PIMS implementation, integration with ISO/IEC 27001, and preparation for privacy-related certification audits.
modules: Introduction to ISO/IEC 27701 and PIMS initiation
PIMS monitoring, improvement, and audit preparation
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding of information privacy is required to attend this training course. You should already be familiar with core privacy concepts (such as PII, consent, data subject rights, processing purposes, and retention), and you will benefit from prior exposure to ISO/IEC 27001-based information security management, risk assessment practices, or privacy compliance activities. No programming or coding experience is needed.
